head: codex/201-authority-protocol-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b1] Establish the quorum-committed authority protocol
body:
Closes #201

## Summary
- commit PrepareAuthority and FinalizeAuthority through production OpenRaft using actual applied log IDs and the exact verified polis, membership epoch, authority cut, and boot generations
- retain opaque voter signer custody, quorum-signed operation evidence, and runtime-owned per-node journal/CAS publication so apply returns pending until durable local reconciliation
- validate snapshot installation against runtime-external custody, reject retired legacy authority state, and reverify complete finalized proposal and endorsement evidence before restored publication
- expose only sealed committed artifact and continuity projections while failing closed on legacy direct authority routes
- retain merge-safe v7 proof with an exact 86-case result contract

## Validation
- exact authority and snapshot suite: 83/83 Rust cases
- semantic denominator: 86 selected = 11 passed, 6 reconciled, 69 rejected
- production snapshot matrix: 36/36
- real three-voter OpenRaft prepare/finalize: 1/1
- legacy public-shape denial: 1/1
- strict production Clippy with warnings denied
- full-history, depth-one source-unavailable, and available-divergent validator modes
- typed validation and doctor PASS
- independent exact-head review: PASS, no P0-P3 findings
